text:
Wish I had discovered this earlier... 🫡

This free, open-source app lets you seamlessly transfer files across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS without cloud services, cables, sign-ups, or even an active internet connection.

~ 100% offline
~ End-to-end encrypted
~ Zero ads or trackers
~ No account needed
~ Cross-platform support

Once you start using it, you'll wonder why you ever uploaded local files to the cloud just to move them between your own devices.

Link 🔗: localsend.org
